title: 'Zero Pollution, Excellent Pickup': Pilots And Students Hail Indigenous Tech As India Launches First Hydrogen-Powered Train
description: India celebrated a milestone with its first hydrogen-powered train, praised by Loco Pilots for its advanced technology, power, soundproof operation, and zero pollution. Loco Pilot Rajesh Kumar emphasized the train's rapid pickup and safety features, highlighting the communication system for emergencies.
